results.title: France: M6 eyes 2027 pay-DTT exit
results.description: M6 Group plans to withdraw its Paris Première channel from French pay-DTT network in 2027, M6 CEO David Larramendy has revealed at a press briefing. After the withdrawal of four Canal+ channels in June 2025, Paris Première remains the last channel still broadcast on pay-DTT. The request for the DTT exit will be submitted to […]

results.title: Nvidia Reaffirms 260,000 GPU Supply to Korea Despite Huang's Exit
results.description: Nvidia reaffirmed its plan to supply 260,000 GPUs to Korea after CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, Korea's science ministry said.
